text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "DiffTRe keeps reweighting the saved decorrelated states, computing gradients and updating θ, for as long as the effective sample size Neff stays at or above a predefined threshold N̄eff. When Neff < N̄eff, the statistical error from reweighting is no longer acceptably small, so a new reference trajectory is sampled using the current θ as the new ˆθ [W3168247670#007]. It starts from the last sampled state SN [W3168247670#006]. At least one θ update per reference trajectory is guaranteed, because initially Neff = N [W3168247670#007]."}
